test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 11 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: If a, b and c are positive integers such that a² + b² = 82 and b² + c² = 65, then the value of 2a + 7b - 3c is:
solution:
**GIVEN:**

a² + b² = 82 

b² + c² = 65 

**FORMULA USED:**

a² - b² = ( a - b) ( a + b) 

**CALCULATION :**

Here we have 

a² + b² = 82 ...............( 1) 

b² + c² = 65................(2)

Subtracting eq(1) - eq(2),we get 

⇒ a² - c² = 17 

⇒ ( a + c) ( a - c) = 17 × 1 [a² - b² = ( a + b) ( a - b) ] 

⇒ a + c = 17 ...............(3)

⇒ a - c = 1..................(4)

On adding eq(3) + eq(4), we get 

⇒ 2a = 18 ⇔ a = 9 

Now, a + c = 17 

⇒ 9 + c = 17 

⇒ c = 8 

Now, put the value of a = 9 in eq (1) we get 

⇒ 9² + b² = 82 

⇒ b² = 82 - 81 

⇒ b = 1 

Now, 2a + 7b - 3c = 2 × 9 + 7 × 1 - 3 × 8 = 1

**Hence, the required value is 1 .**
